column1: # the merge of the base and the head still names a path the PR deletes or
# renames is one `NOTE callers-not-ported: <file>:<line> still references <old>,
# ...` line, which the lead review request notes carry.
# bin/lib/callers-not-ported.sh has the rule. It is a NOTE in every mode:
# `refuse` is read as `note`, so the rule never refuses and never changes the
# verdict. Set the mode to off to turn it off. param and match are unused (-).
